terrain.vertex_color: Color; RGB linear sand/grass albedo, A grass weight
terrain.fbx_import: Import Uniform Scale=1, Convert Scene=true, Convert Scene Unit=true; centimeter metadata; do not force front X axis.

formulas.d_cm: r-R_cm; signed radial horizontal shore distance, positive water side

bathymetry.pixel_sampling: Texel centers; first file pixel (-4092,+4092) cm; 8 cm/texel; clamp address mode
bathymetry.approximation: R is radial distance to analytic polar coastline, not exact Euclidean shortest distance. Both mesh and mask evaluate exactly the same height function; mesh linearly interpolates 32 cm triangles, EXR samples 8 cm pixels and quantizes to float16.

validation.tool: Blender 5.0.0 independent fresh process FBX import and EXR load
validation.notes: FBX reimport uses centimeter scene. Maximum depth error is at the far offshore -320 cm floor clamp; near-shore height error is under 0.026 cm. Actual UE imported asset bounds and UV orientation must still be confirmed by Unreal import owner. Top-left EXR file UV has V toward world -Y.

source_preview.scope: Blender source geometry preview with temporary ocean and lighting; these preview elements are absent from the editable blend and FBX. This is not a screenshot of Unreal materials or the final test map.
